card_text: Color and perms from Hobbs: the two long appointments that make a long drive make sense.

seo.title: Men's Hair Color & Perm for Hobbs, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Men's hair color and perms for Hobbs, done in Carlsbad west on US 62/180. How to give a Color Transformation or a Perm the whole day. Book on Booksy.

paragraphs: A Color Transformation is the longest booking on my menu, and a Perm isn't far behind. Both happen in my chair in Carlsbad, {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles from Hobbs along {{city:hobbs.route}}, about {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes by car (OpenStreetMap routing).
Of everything I do, these two are the appointments that give a long drive a reason: one trip, one big change.

items.title: Color Transformation
items.body: Bleach and tone to the shade you pick. Booksy blocks {{minutes:color-transformation}}; from Hobbs, that means the whole day.

items.title: Perm
items.body: Volume, texture and movement set into hair that lies flat. {{minutes:perm}} in the chair.

blocks.heading: Give it the day.
paragraphs: Add the drive both ways to {{minutes:color-transformation}} in the chair and the day is spoken for. Book a morning slot, eat before you leave Hobbs, and don't put anything behind it.
A Perm is shorter, but still long enough that I'd give that day nothing else except the trip home.

blocks.heading: Lighter hair, milder heat.
paragraphs: Hobbs runs a touch cooler than Carlsbad: an average July high of {{city:hobbs.july_high_f}} and about {{city:hobbs.days_100f}} days a year at 100°F or more, against {{city:carlsbad.july_high_f}} and {{city:carlsbad.days_100f}} here (Open-Meteo, 2023–25). Bleached hair and a fresh perm both ask for some care in the sun and heat, so if you're planning the change for summer, that's one small thing in your favor.
Send me a photo of the shade or the wave you want by text before you book, so we agree on where it lands before you drive. Color stays on the head; I don't dye beards.

blocks.heading: Color and perm questions from Hobbs.

items.q: How long should I set aside for a Color Transformation from Hobbs?
items.a: {{minutes:color-transformation}} in the chair, plus about {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes each way.

items.q: Can I get a cut and the color in one visit?
items.a: Text me what you have in mind before booking and I'll tell you how to schedule it.
{{price:perm}}, with {{minutes:perm}} held on Booksy. The color and perm page has photos.
